text.card: A red giant 3,631 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.29 solar masses and 12.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,974 K at its surface.
